name: jupyter-enhancements
description: Supercharge Jupyter Notebooks with visual cues (Flash, Backgrounds, Borders) and smart execution controls.

jupyterEnhancements.layout.enableCompact.description: Enables a tight layout: Verbose timing, Line numbers ON, Small output font, Consolidated Run Button, etc.

jupyterEnhancements.layout.hideCellToolb.description: Hides the floating cell toolbar (Run/Delete/etc) when enabled. Shows it on the right when disabled.

jupyterEnhancements.general.flashDuratio.description: Duration of the flash effect in milliseconds.

jupyterEnhancements.background.enable.description: Enable persistent background colors (Green/Red) after execution.

jupyterEnhancements.background.successCo.description: Background color for successfully executed cells.

jupyterEnhancements.flash.enable.description: Enable a brief flash effect upon successful execution.

jupyterEnhancements.innerBorder.enable.description: Enable a border around the code text (Command Box) while running.

jupyterEnhancements.innerBorder.persist.description: Keep the inner border (Dark Green) visible after success.

jupyterEnhancements.innerBorder.runningC.description: Color of the inner border while running (Blue).

jupyterEnhancements.innerBorder.successC.description: Color of the inner border after success.

jupyterEnhancements.outerBorder.enable.description: Enable a thick indicator bar on the left side of the cell while running.

jupyterEnhancements.outerBorder.persist.description: Keep the outer indicator (Dark Green) visible after success.

jupyterEnhancements.outerBorder.runningC.description: Color of the outer indicator while running (Blue).

jupyterEnhancements.outerBorder.successC.description: Color of the outer indicator after success.

jupyterEnhancements.scratchpad.borderCol.description: Border color for Scratchpad cells. (Default: F11. To change, press Ctrl+K Ctrl+S and search for 'jupyter-enhancements.runInScratchpad')

jupyterEnhancements.scratchpad.borderSty.description: Border style for Scratchpad cells. (Default: F11. To change, press Ctrl+K Ctrl+S and search for 'jupyter-enhancements.runInScratchpad')

jupyterEnhancements.scratchpad.borderWid.description: Border width for Scratchpad cells. (Default: F11. To change, press Ctrl+K Ctrl+S and search for 'jupyter-enhancements.runInScratchpad')

jupyterEnhancements.scratchpad.backgroun.description: Optional background color for Scratchpad cells.
